svg.title: Saturn code map

g.text: command line, runs tui, starts engine

svg.text: When the target is Claude Code

g.text: If no engine is running, cli starts saturn-engine and tui attaches over the socket
The input reaches the provider only after the record store has accepted it
In the same flow, engine passes the input to Claude Code
tui, core, and engine all use the message types of protocol, and engine implements the core traits
